recipes.label: Ego Level 1
recipes.startdescription: You start to feel a creeping sense of fear and uncertainty. It feels like your identity is being threatened by change and you don't know how to handle it. [Warning if you get to level 10 you will die]

slots.label: Forge Influence
slots.description: Forge Influence can be used to protect yourself and start to combat the ego plague.

recipes.label: Ego Level 2
recipes.startdescription: Your fear starts to grow into loneliness. You're starting to feel isolated because of your rigid self-concept. [Warning if you get to level 10 you will die]

slots.label: Forge Influence
slots.description: Forge Influence can be used to protect yourself and continue to combat the ego plague.

recipes.label: Ego Level 3
recipes.startdescription: The sense of isolation deepens. You're scared of changing your identity, even if the change is good for you. [Warning if you get to level 10 you will die]

slots.label: Forge Influence
slots.description: Forge Influence can be used to protect yourself and challenge your rigid beliefs and behaviors.

recipes.label: Ego Level 4
recipes.startdescription: Your ego makes you reject others' perspectives. You believe only your own perspective is valid. [Warning if you get to level 10 you will die]

slots.label: Forge Influence
slots.description: Forge Influence can be used to challenge your one-sided views and open your mind to other perspectives.

recipes.label: Ego Level 5
recipes.startdescription: Your ego makes you believe you're always right. You have difficulty accepting criticism or recognizing your own faults. [Warning if you get to level 10 you will die]

slots.label: Forge Influence
slots.description: Forge Influence can be used to challenge your self-righteousness and learn to accept criticism constructively.

recipes.label: Ego Level 6
recipes.startdescription: Your ego makes you unable to admit your mistakes. You blame others for your failures instead of taking responsibility. [Warning if you get to level 10 you will die]

slots.label: Forge Influence
slots.description: Forge Influence can be used to combat your ego's denial and blame, helping you to take responsibility for your actions.

recipes.label: Ego Level 7
recipes.startdescription: Your ego makes you prioritize your own needs over others'. You struggle to empathize and connect with other people. [Warning if you get to level 10 you will die]

slots.label: Forge Influence
slots.description: Forge Influence can be used to break through your self-centeredness, fostering empathy and connection with others.

recipes.label: Ego Level 8
recipes.startdescription: Your ego makes you feel superior to others. You lack humility and find it difficult to relate to others on equal terms. [Warning if you get to level 10 you will die]

slots.label: Forge Influence
slots.description: Forge Influence can be used to combat your feelings of superiority, promoting humility and equality.

recipes.label: Ego Level 9
recipes.startdescription: Your ego makes you defensive and resistant to change. You find it hard to learn and grow. [Warning if you get to level 10 you will die]

slots.label: Forge Influence
slots.description: Forge Influence can be used to break down your defenses and embrace change and growth.

recipes.label: Ego Level 10
recipes.startdescription: Your ego is overwhelming. You're completely trapped in your self-concept and unable to adapt to new situations or challenges. [You've reached level 10 - any further and you will die]

slots.label: Forge Influence
slots.description: Forge Influence can be used to protect yourself and finally overcome the ego plague.

recipes.label: ego resolved
recipes.startdescription: I feel the pull of the current lessen, the wave of confusion starts to subside. The balance between my instincts and rationality begins to restore.
recipes.description: A breath of fresh air fills my lungs as I resurface from the overwhelming waves of wantonness and analysis paralysis. The waters of life seem more navigable now.

recipes.label: Ego Resolved
recipes.startdescription: You've begun the difficult process of ego death, focusing on objective ways to improve and grow.
recipes.description: You've successfully overcome the ego plague, breaking free from the trap of your rigid self-concept. You now can adapt to change and challenges, empathize with others, and maintain a humble and equal approach towards others. Your ego is no longer in control.
